releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.57 brings Files into the new dark glass visual system while preserving the existing local file summary, filename/type search, scan, categories and file actions. The persistent Home / Files / Notes / Library / Settings dock is now dark glass, fixed below the page content, and the Files scroll area keeps clear breathing room above it. The redesign uses lightweight translucent surfaces and shadows rather than continuous full-screen blur.
